description: Check whether one URL is really live. Returns state live (answered 2xx), redirected (with finalUrl), dead (confirmed 4xx/5xx or a domain that does not exist), blocked (alive but bot protection refused every tier) or unverified (timeout, unreachable host, throttled, or a first 404 awaiting confirmation), plus the HTTP status, the tier that answered (1 plain fetch, 2 TLS-impersonating fetch, 3 real browser) and whether the answer came from cache. Costs 1 credit (external_link), charged only when the answer is live, redirected or dead; blocked and unverified answers are free. Only absolute http(s) URLs: action or token links (logout, unsubscribe, magic or signed links) are refused. It sends no custom or auth headers and does not return page content. Requires the audits:write scope.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL to verify.

name: verify_url
